entries.prompt: When will the staff meeting begin?
entries.promptZh: 員工會議什麼時候開始？

options.label: B
options.text: The meeting room is on the second floor.

entries.explanation: When 問時間，A 回答明天早上九點半；B 是地點，C 是會議主題。

entries.prompt: Could you print twenty copies of this report?
entries.promptZh: 可以幫我印二十份這份報告嗎？

options.label: B
options.text: Sure, I will bring them to your desk.
options.translation: 沒問題，我會送到你的桌上。

options.label: C
options.text: It was a very interesting report.
options.translation: 那是一份很有趣的報告。

entries.explanation: 這是 Could you 開頭的請求。B 表示願意幫忙；A、C 都沒有回應列印的請求。

entries.prompt: Who is responsible for ordering office supplies?
entries.promptZh: 誰負責訂購辦公用品？

options.label: A
options.translation: 我們通常在網路上訂購。

entries.explanation: Who 問負責的人，因此選 C。A 回答方式，B 回答到貨時間。

entries.prompt: Has the manager approved the budget yet?
entries.promptZh: 經理已經核准預算了嗎？

options.label: B
options.text: The manager sits near the window.

entries.explanation: 問題詢問預算是否已核准。A 用「仍在審核」間接表示尚未完成，不一定要用 Yes 或 No 回答。

entries.prompt: Where should I leave the signed contract?
entries.promptZh: 簽好的合約應該放在哪裡？

options.label: B
options.text: Please put it in the blue folder on my desk.
options.translation: 請放在我桌上的藍色資料夾裡。

options.label: C
options.text: The contract lasts for two years.

entries.explanation: Where 問放置地點，B 說明應放在桌上的藍色資料夾裡。A 是時間，C 是期限。

entries.prompt: Why was the presentation postponed?
entries.promptZh: 簡報為什麼延期了？

options.label: A
options.text: It will take about thirty minutes.

options.label: B
options.text: I prepared some slides for it.
options.translation: 我為簡報準備了一些投影片。

options.label: C
options.text: The client asked for more time to prepare.
options.translation: 客戶要求多一點準備時間。

entries.explanation: Why 問原因，C 解釋客戶需要更多準備時間。A 是所需時間，B 是準備內容。

entries.prompt: Would you like me to reserve a larger room?
entries.promptZh: 需要我幫忙預訂大一點的會議室嗎？

options.label: A
options.text: Yes, we are expecting twelve people.
options.translation: 好，我們預計會有十二個人。

options.label: B
options.text: The room has a large window.
options.translation: 那間房間有一扇大窗戶。

options.label: C
options.text: I reserved a train ticket yesterday.
options.translation: 我昨天訂了一張火車票。

entries.explanation: 這是主動提供協助。A 接受提議，並說明有十二人參加的需求；B、C 沒有回應這項提議。

entries.prompt: How can I register for the training session?
entries.promptZh: 我要怎麼報名這場訓練？

options.label: A
options.translation: 那場訓練持續了兩小時。

options.label: B
options.text: Fill out the form on the staff website.
options.translation: 填寫員工網站上的表格。

entries.explanation: How can I 問報名方法，B 提供明確步驟；A 是時間長度，C 是講師資訊。

entries.prompt: Is Daniel available to discuss the project now?
entries.promptZh: Daniel 現在有空討論專案嗎？

options.label: A
options.text: The project is about new software.
options.translation: 這個專案是關於新軟體的。

options.label: B
options.translation: 我們上星期二討論過了。

options.label: C
options.text: He is with a customer until three.
options.translation: 他三點以前都在接待客戶。

entries.explanation: C 表示 Daniel 目前正在接待客戶，間接回答現在沒空。A、B 都沒有說明他現在是否有空。

entries.prompt: Please send me a reminder before the deadline.
entries.promptZh: 請在截止期限前提醒我。

options.label: A
options.text: I will email you on Thursday morning.
options.translation: 我星期四早上會寄信提醒你。

options.label: B
options.text: The email address belongs to the supplier.
options.translation: 那個電子郵件地址是供應商的。

options.label: C
options.text: The line outside was very long.

entries.explanation: 這是一個提醒的請求。A 承諾寄信提醒；B、C 沒有回應請求。deadline 指截止期限，與 line 的隊伍意思不同。

entries.prompt: Where can I catch the airport shuttle?
entries.promptZh: 我在哪裡可以搭機場接駁車？

options.label: C
options.text: The airport is quite busy today.

entries.explanation: Where 問乘車地點，B 回答主要入口外。A 是班次頻率，C 是機場的狀況。

entries.prompt: Why has our flight been delayed?
entries.promptZh: 我們的班機為什麼延誤了？

options.label: B
options.text: Your seat is next to the aisle.

options.label: C
options.text: There is heavy fog at the destination.

entries.explanation: Why 問延誤原因，C 的濃霧是合理原因；A 是目的地，B 是座位資訊。

entries.prompt: May I see your boarding pass, please?
entries.promptZh: 可以讓我看一下你的登機證嗎？

options.label: B
options.text: I enjoyed the flight very much.

options.label: C
options.text: The board is made of wood.

entries.explanation: May I see 是查看文件的禮貌請求，A 提供登機證。不要被 boarding 和 board 的相似字形誤導。

entries.prompt: What time does the hotel serve breakfast?
entries.promptZh: 飯店幾點供應早餐？

options.label: C
options.text: I would prefer a room with a view.
options.translation: 我比較想要有景觀的房間。

entries.explanation: What time 問時間，B 提供早餐時段；A 是餐廳數量，C 是房型偏好。

entries.prompt: Who should I contact about my missing suitcase?
entries.promptZh: 行李箱不見了，我應該聯絡誰？

options.label: A
options.translation: 我的行李箱是深綠色的。

options.label: B
options.translation: 這趟飛行花了三個小時。

options.label: C
options.text: The agent at the baggage service desk.

entries.explanation: Who 問應聯絡的人，C 指向行李服務人員。A 描述外觀，B 描述飛行時間。

entries.prompt: How far is the station from the conference venue?
entries.promptZh: 車站離會議場地有多遠？

options.label: A
options.text: It is about a ten-minute walk.

options.label: C
options.text: The train ticket is in my bag.

entries.explanation: How far 問距離，也能用步行所需時間回答。A 合適；B、C 分別是活動時間和物品位置。

entries.prompt: Can I pay for the taxi with a credit card?
entries.promptZh: 計程車可以刷信用卡付款嗎？

options.label: B
options.text: Yes, most major cards are accepted.
options.translation: 可以，大多數主要信用卡都能使用。

options.label: C
options.text: My office is near the bank.
options.translation: 我的辦公室在銀行附近。

entries.explanation: 問題詢問付款方式。B 明確說可以使用信用卡；A、C 都只提供地點資訊。

entries.prompt: We will arrive after midnight. Can you keep our reservation?
entries.promptZh: 我們會在午夜後抵達，可以保留我們的訂房嗎？

options.label: A
options.text: Our hotel was built last year.

options.label: B
options.text: I arrived at the office early.

options.label: C
options.text: Of course. I will note your late arrival.
options.translation: 當然，我會註記你們較晚抵達。

entries.explanation: 旅客要求保留訂房。C 同意並記錄晚到資訊；A、B 無法處理這個需求。

entries.prompt: Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat?
entries.promptZh: 你比較喜歡靠窗還是靠走道的座位？

options.label: A
options.text: A window seat, if one is available.
options.translation: 如果還有的話，我想要靠窗座位。

options.label: B
options.text: Yes, I have seen that window.

entries.explanation: 這是二選一的偏好問題，A 選擇靠窗。B 的 Yes 沒有選擇座位，C 與偏好無關。

entries.prompt: Is there an additional fee to change my train ticket?
entries.promptZh: 更改火車票需要額外費用嗎？

options.label: B
options.text: There is no charge if you change it today.
options.translation: 如果今天更改就不收費。

options.label: C
options.text: I bought some tickets for the concert.
options.translation: 我買了幾張演唱會門票。

entries.explanation: B 直接回答改票是否收費，並補充今天更改免費的條件。A、C 沒有回答費用問題。

entries.prompt: Do I need the receipt to return this item?
entries.promptZh: 退這件商品需要收據嗎？

options.label: A
options.text: The item is on the top shelf.
options.translation: 商品在最上層的架子上。

options.label: B
options.text: I received a call this morning.
options.translation: 我今天早上接到一通電話。

options.label: C
options.text: Yes, please bring it with the item.
options.translation: 需要，請把收據和商品一起帶來。

entries.explanation: C 回答退貨需要收據。receipt 是收據，不能因為 received 的發音相近而選 B。

entries.prompt: When is payment for this invoice due?
entries.promptZh: 這張發票的付款期限是什麼時候？

options.label: A
options.text: By the end of this month.

options.label: B
options.text: Please send the package by courier.

options.label: C
options.text: The invoice number is at the top.

entries.explanation: When 和 due 詢問付款期限，A 回答月底以前；B 是寄送方式，C 是號碼的位置。

entries.prompt: Could you tell me when my package will arrive?
entries.promptZh: 可以告訴我包裹什麼時候會送達嗎？

options.label: B
options.text: It is scheduled for delivery tomorrow.

options.label: C
options.text: The shipping box is quite large.

entries.explanation: 雖以 Could you 開頭，重點是 when my package will arrive。B 回答預計送達時間。

entries.prompt: How long will the discount be available?
entries.promptZh: 折扣會持續多久？

options.label: A
options.text: The store is on the first floor.

entries.explanation: How long 問促銷持續期間。C 提供結束時間；A 是地點，B 是個人習慣。

entries.prompt: Do you have this jacket in a larger size?
entries.promptZh: 這件外套有大一點的尺寸嗎？

options.label: A
options.text: Let me check our stock for you.

entries.explanation: A 提議查庫存，是對尺寸需求的合理回應；此題不必用 Yes 或 No 開頭。

entries.prompt: I need to reschedule my appointment for Friday.
entries.promptZh: 我需要把預約改到星期五。

options.label: A
options.text: The office is near the clinic.

options.label: B
options.text: Would ten in the morning work for you?

options.label: C
options.text: The appointment took half an hour.

entries.explanation: 對方提出改期需求，B 進一步確認可行時間。A 是地點，C 是過去一次預約的長度。

entries.prompt: May I speak to someone in technical support?
entries.promptZh: 可以請技術支援人員接電話嗎？

options.label: A
options.text: The support team has six members.

options.label: C
options.text: Please hold while I transfer your call.

entries.explanation: C 的轉接處理符合找技術支援人員的要求；A、B 沒有協助接通。

entries.prompt: What should I do if the device stops working?
entries.promptZh: 如果裝置停止運作，我該怎麼辦？

options.label: A
options.text: Contact us for a replacement under the warranty.
options.translation: 請聯絡我們，依保固辦理更換。

entries.explanation: What should I do 問處理方法，A 提供聯絡和更換流程；B、C 不是處理故障的方法。

entries.prompt: How many people will be joining your dinner reservation?
entries.promptZh: 你的晚餐訂位總共有幾個人？

options.label: A
options.translation: 這間餐廳供應義大利料理。

options.label: C
options.text: We would like to sit by the window.

entries.explanation: How many people 問人數，B 回答六人。A 是料理種類，C 是座位偏好。

entries.prompt: Can I cancel my subscription before the next payment?
entries.promptZh: 我可以在下次付款前取消訂閱嗎？

options.label: A
options.translation: 你的帳戶名稱顯示在這裡。

options.label: B
options.text: The next train leaves in ten minutes.
options.translation: 下一班火車十分鐘後開。

options.label: C
options.text: Yes, use the cancellation option in your account settings.
options.translation: 可以，在帳戶設定中選擇取消訂閱。

entries.explanation: C 回答可否取消，並提供操作方法。A 只談帳戶名稱，B 的 next train 與 next payment 無關。

entries.prompt: Who will lead the presentation?
entries.promptZh: 誰將負責這場簡報？

options.label: A
options.text: Ms. Park from the sales department.
options.translation: 銷售部的 Park 女士。

entries.explanation: 問 Who，應回答人。

entries.prompt: Where did you put the signed contracts?
entries.promptZh: 你把已簽署的合約放在哪裡？

options.label: C
options.text: On the top shelf beside the printer.
options.translation: 放在印表機旁邊的最上層架子上。

entries.explanation: 問 Where，應回答地點。

entries.prompt: When is the maintenance crew expected to arrive?
entries.promptZh: 維修人員預計何時抵達？
entries.explanation: 問 When，應回答時間。

entries.prompt: Why was the meeting postponed?
entries.promptZh: 會議為什麼延期？
entries.explanation: 問 Why，應回答原因。

entries.prompt: How often is the equipment inspected?
entries.promptZh: 這套設備多久檢查一次？
entries.explanation: How often 問頻率。

entries.prompt: Would you mind sending me the revised schedule?
entries.promptZh: 可以麻煩你把修訂後的時程寄給我嗎？

options.label: C
options.text: Not at all. I'll send it right away.
options.translation: 當然不介意，我會立刻寄出。

entries.explanation: Would you mind...? 接受請求可回答 Not at all。

entries.prompt: Haven't the invoices been mailed yet?
entries.promptZh: 那些發票還沒寄出去嗎？

options.label: C
options.translation: 還沒，因為印表機故障了。

entries.explanation: 否定疑問句仍依事實回答；此處說明尚未寄出的原因。

entries.prompt: Could you reserve a table for six tonight?
entries.promptZh: 你可以幫今晚六個人訂位嗎？

options.label: A
options.text: Certainly. What time would you prefer?

options.label: C
options.text: The table is made of wood.

entries.explanation: 對請求最自然的回應是答應並確認時間。

entries.prompt: Which route should we take to the airport?
entries.promptZh: 我們去機場應該走哪條路？
entries.explanation: Which route 問路線選擇。

entries.prompt: Do you know whether the cafeteria is still open?
entries.promptZh: 你知道員工餐廳是否還在營業嗎？

options.label: A
options.text: The sandwiches are on the counter.

options.label: C
options.text: It closes at eight, so we still have time.
options.translation: 它八點關門，所以我們還有時間。

entries.explanation: 回答營業狀態並提供時間。

entries.prompt: Why don't we review the proposal after lunch?
entries.promptZh: 我們何不午餐後再審查提案？

options.label: A
options.text: That sounds like a good idea.

entries.explanation: Why don't we...? 是提議。

entries.prompt: How many copies of the report do we need?
entries.promptZh: 這份報告需要幾份副本？
entries.explanation: How many 問數量。

entries.prompt: Isn't Mr. Gomez attending the trade show?
entries.promptZh: Gomez 先生不是要參加商展嗎？
entries.explanation: 依事實回答否定疑問句。

entries.prompt: Whose umbrella is this by the door?
entries.promptZh: 門邊這把雨傘是誰的？

options.label: C
options.text: I think it belongs to Ms. Lee.
options.translation: 我想它是 Lee 女士的。

entries.explanation: Whose 問所有人。

entries.prompt: Could I get an aisle seat, please?
entries.promptZh: 可以給我一個走道座位嗎？

options.label: A
options.translation: 我來查看看目前有哪些座位。

entries.explanation: 服務情境中應確認座位供應狀況。

entries.prompt: What do you think of the new office layout?
entries.promptZh: 你覺得新的辦公室配置如何？

options.label: B
options.text: It's much easier to move around now.

entries.explanation: What do you think of...? 問意見。

entries.prompt: Where can I find the warranty information?
entries.promptZh: 我在哪裡可以找到保固資訊？

options.label: C
options.text: It's printed on the last page.

entries.explanation: 問位置，回答在最後一頁。

entries.prompt: Should I call the supplier now or wait until tomorrow?
entries.promptZh: 我應該現在打給供應商，還是等到明天？

options.label: A
options.text: Call now, in case the office closes early.
options.translation: 現在就打，以免辦公室提早關門。

entries.explanation: 選擇問句應直接給建議。

entries.prompt: How was your interview this morning?
entries.promptZh: 你今天早上的面試如何？

options.label: B
options.text: It went better than I expected.

entries.explanation: How was...? 問經驗或感受。

entries.prompt: Has the finance department approved the budget?
entries.promptZh: 財務部已經核准預算了嗎？

options.label: A
options.text: Not yet, but they expect to finish today.
options.translation: 還沒，不過他們預計今天完成。

entries.explanation: 現在完成式 Yes/No 問句，回答目前狀態。

entries.prompt: When will the new catalog be available?
entries.promptZh: 新目錄何時可以取得？
entries.explanation: When 問時間，應回答下個月初。

entries.prompt: Would you like me to make a copy of the receipt?
entries.promptZh: 需要我影印一份收據嗎？
entries.explanation: Would you like me to...? 是主動提供協助，最自然的是接受或婉拒。

entries.prompt: Didn't the technician replace this part yesterday?
entries.promptZh: 技術人員昨天不是已經更換這個零件了嗎？

options.label: A
options.text: No, the replacement hasn't arrived yet.
options.translation: 沒有，替換零件還沒送到。

entries.explanation: 否定疑問句仍依事實回答；此處說明尚未更換的原因。

entries.prompt: Who should I contact about my travel reimbursement?
entries.promptZh: 關於差旅費報銷，我應該聯絡誰？
entries.explanation: Who 問聯絡對象。

entries.prompt: Why don't we move the display closer to the entrance?
entries.promptZh: 我們何不把展示架移到入口附近？

options.label: A
options.translation: 那可能會吸引更多顧客。

entries.explanation: Why don't we...? 是建議，應回應是否同意。

entries.prompt: How long will the software installation take?
entries.promptZh: 軟體安裝需要多久？
entries.explanation: How long 問持續時間。

entries.prompt: Could you tell me where the orientation is being held?
entries.promptZh: 你可以告訴我新人說明會在哪裡舉行嗎？

options.label: A
options.text: In the auditorium on the first floor.

entries.explanation: where 問地點。

entries.prompt: Shouldn't we order more printer paper before the holiday?
entries.promptZh: 我們不是應該在假日前多訂一些影印紙嗎？

options.label: A
options.text: Yes, I'll add it to the supply order.
options.translation: 是的，我會把它加進用品訂單。

options.label: B
options.text: The printer is near my desk.

entries.explanation: Shouldn't we...? 帶有建議意味，最自然的是同意並採取行動。

entries.prompt: Which candidate has the most management experience?
entries.promptZh: 哪位候選人的管理經驗最豐富？

options.label: A
options.text: The one who worked in Toronto.
options.translation: 那位曾在多倫多工作的人。

entries.explanation: Which candidate 問特定候選人。

entries.prompt: Has the customer confirmed the delivery address?
entries.promptZh: 顧客已經確認送貨地址了嗎？

options.label: C
options.text: Not yet, so I sent another e-mail.
options.translation: 還沒，所以我又寄了一封電子郵件。

entries.explanation: 現在完成式問目前是否已完成；回答尚未並說明後續行動。

entries.prompt: Where should I leave the completed forms?
entries.promptZh: 我應該把填好的表格放在哪裡？

options.label: C
options.text: In the tray beside my desk.
options.translation: 放在我桌邊的文件盤裡。

entries.explanation: Where 問放置地點。

entries.prompt: Would it be possible to extend the deadline?
entries.promptZh: 有可能延長截止期限嗎？

options.label: B
options.text: I can ask the project manager.

entries.explanation: 對能否延期的詢問，最自然的回應是表示會向負責人確認。

entries.prompt: Who approved the revised advertising budget?
entries.promptZh: 誰核准了修訂後的廣告預算？
entries.explanation: Who 問執行核准的人。

entries.prompt: Why hasn't the replacement part arrived?
entries.promptZh: 替換零件為什麼還沒到？

options.label: A
options.text: The supplier shipped it to the wrong address.

options.label: B
options.text: Then let's notify the evening-shift staff.
options.translation: 那我們通知晚班員工吧。

entries.explanation: 移轉延長會影響晚班；通知晚班員工是最合理的情境反應。

entries.prompt: How many candidates have confirmed their interview times?
entries.promptZh: 有多少位應徵者已確認面試時間？
entries.explanation: How many 詢問數量；six have confirmed 提供人數。

entries.prompt: Didn't the supplier agree to cover the rush fee?
entries.promptZh: 供應商不是同意負擔急件費嗎？

options.label: A
options.text: Only if we ordered before noon.
options.translation: 只有在我們中午前下單的情況下。

entries.explanation: 否定問句詢問供應商是否同意負擔急件費；Only if... 說明該承諾附帶的條件，是最切合的回應。

entries.prompt: Who's taking minutes while Lena presents the quarterly forecast?
entries.promptZh: Lena 報告季度預測時，誰要做會議紀錄？

options.label: C
options.text: I can, unless Martin has already volunteered.
options.translation: 我可以，除非 Martin 已經自願了。

entries.explanation: Who's taking minutes 詢問由誰記錄會議內容；I can 直接承接工作，unless 子句補充可能已有志願者。

entries.prompt: The backup server still hasn't synchronized with the billing system.
entries.promptZh: 備援伺服器仍未與計費系統同步。

options.label: C
options.text: It is stored in the supply cabinet.

entries.explanation: 備援伺服器尚未同步，合理後續是延後系統切換；then 表示根據前述狀況採取決定。
